The '''Conjenus system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located within the [[Vish sector/Legends|Vish sector]], a part of the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] regions known as the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]<ref name="EAOC" /> and the [[Trailing Sectors/Legends|Trailing Sectors]].<ref name="Trailing Sectors" /> It was home to the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Conjeni/Legends|Conjeni]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="Treasure Hunt" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Conjenus system was established in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which placed the system in grid square N-16.<ref name="EAOC" />
